verdict.rationale: The Search API is documented as returning real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with extracted page text explicitly intended "for your own model." It is positioned for raw results you process yourself, and the SDK exposes `max_results` to control result count; the CLI returns query-relevant page snippets. Ranking and LLM-ready extracted content are clearly first-party, but sizing beyond result count is only implied. Missing for 10: documented per-result content or token-budget sizing controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG context quality.
